name: rosetta-harshad-or-niven-series
code:
use default

digit_sum(value: int) -> int =>
    if value < 10 then
        value
    else
        value % 10 + digit_sum(value / 10)
    fi

harshad() -> Pipe[int] =>
    stream(1, number => number || number + 1)
        |> filter(number => number % digit_sum(number) == 0)

let first_twenty = harshad()
    |> take(20)
    |> map(number => "{number}")
    |> join(" ")

write_line("first 20 Harshad numbers: {first_twenty}")

let beyond_thousand = harshad()
    |> filter(number => number > 1000)
    |> first_or_throw()

write_line("first Harshad number above 1000: {beyond_thousand}")
